message: The other day, I was trying to teach my kids about fire safety, and let me tell you, it turned into quite the debate! I explained the importance of smoke alarms, and they insisted on testing ours right away. I thought it’d be a quick check, but it turned into a full-blown ‘who can make the loudest alarm noise’ competition! 😂 In the end, we not only confirmed our alarm works, but we also created a little escape plan together. It was a fun reminder that even serious topics can bring us closer. How do you make safety lessons engaging for your kids?
